title: Subpoena Reissue Table — Reopened Hearings in Unemployment Insurance Appeals
content:
Granted subpoena requests on an appeal reopened after dismissal give the reopened setting its subpoena reissue days under Unemployment Insurance Appeals.

**Rule.** The reopened-setting subpoena reissue days are the two-subpoena reissue days when two or more subpoena requests on the appeal stand granted, the one-subpoena reissue days when exactly one does, and zero days when none does. The reopened hearing date found from the reopened-setting clock and the reopened-setting window is moved later by these days before the notice minimum and the weekend rule are applied.

| Subpoena requests on the appeal standing granted | Reissue days |
|---|---|
| two or more | 10 |
| exactly one | 7 |
| none | 0 |

## What is counted

Subpoena requests recorded on the appeal whose status is granted. A request still standing received (not yet decided) or one denied is not counted.

*Cases (hypothetical):* two granted and one received — 10 days; one granted and one denied — 7 days; two received, none granted — 0 days.
